policies.title: Libyan ordinary passports: Bangladesh advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh's official portal accepts Libyan applications but requires the printed online submission, supporting documents and passport to be lodged with a Bangladesh mission for visa issuance before travel.
conditions: The online form is an application, not an electronically issued visa. Use the Libyan ordinary passport, print the submitted form, and lodge it with required documents, fees and passport at the Bangladesh visa office or mission for issuance before travel.

The portal lists Tripoli, Libya among supported online-submission locations and separately lists the Libyan passport fee. Visitor purpose, duration, supporting documents, carrier rules and final admission remain subject to the Bangladesh mission and border authorities.

application.label: Bangladesh Department of Immigration and Passports online visa application
steps: Submit the online application using the Libyan ordinary passport.
Print the submitted form and lodge it with the required documents, fee and passport at the Bangladesh visa office or mission before travel.
Travel only after the mission has issued the visa and comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Libyan ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Libyan visitor and makes the electronic tourist-visa route available from anywhere except the United States.
conditions: The source names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; an ordinary Libyan passport holder without Cuban residency must obtain a tourist visa. Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel; the D'Viajeros declaration is separate.
The tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, with a possible 90-day extension. Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Libyan passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Libyan ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d'Ivoire's official ordinary-passport process gives online preapproval and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: The route is for a valid ordinary passport. Complete pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, passport and yellow-fever certificate.

At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa. Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit the ordinary Libyan passport pre-enrolment and payment online, with the listed travel and hosting documents.
Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

policies.title: Libyan citizens: Libya
policies.summary: Libya's official foreigner-entry statute distinguishes foreigners, so an ordinary Libyan passport holder entering Libya is classified as citizenship rather than a visa route.
conditions: This records nationality/citizenship only. Passport validity, border operations, identity documentation, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.
